objective: Maximize empirical safe input/output compression frontier; capability, agentic execution and workflow preservation take priority
quality_gate: No observed degradation on prespecified Q/A/W checks; quantify uncertainty and do not infer universal equivalence
metrics: resident context size separate from cumulative input
long_horizon_requirement: At least one adversarial 50-turn case with a turn-1 fact becoming decisive at turn 50; frozen checks before candidate runs
rules: Raw recoverability does not by itself establish successful retrieval or decision quality
Count all model calls, workers, retries and recovery
Preserve model reasoning settings, tool availability and permissions within pairs
Report input and output separately; do not equate token count with semantic information
Finite benchmark estimates an empirical frontier, not a global maximum
